title: Crazy Train
summary:
The unprecedented gyrations in the freight market
In 1980, legendary rockstar Ozzy Osbourne wrote the heavy metal classic "Crazy Train". The lyrics, referencing the tense geopolitical climate during the cold war, include the phrase "going off the rails on a crazy train". In the current day and age, amid another geopolitical crisis, this might as well refer to the tanker freight market going off the rails.
